title: NPDev browser-AI relay: element upsert (npdev-elements.json)
description: F4 (plan 4.6). For models too big to send back whole: the AI returns only the root-array ELEMENTS it created or changed, each COMPLETE, plus removals and renames. NPDev expands it deterministically: start from the base model; for each upsert key K and element e, replace the element of base[K] whose 'name' equals e.name, or append; apply removals; then run the normal pipeline (desire-paths, validate, diff gate, which checks renames/removals against npdev-submission.json). Keys of 'upsert' must be root array keys of model.schema.json (concepts, flows, pages, ...); the expander rejects any other. Element identity is 'name' -- confirm per key in model.schema.json before enabling a key (task T4.2).

remove.description: Root key -> names to remove, e.g. {"concepts": ["OldThing"]}. Field-level removals are expressed by upserting the whole concept without the field.
